title: [ingest] python_display_short_literal_types defaults to False
summary: `python_display_short_literal_types` controls whether `Literal[1, 2, 3]` is rendered in PEP-604 short form (`1 | 2 | 3`). It defaults to `False` (long form). The option is an "env" rebuild trigger, so changing it requires a full rebuild. Relevant for documentation targeting Python 3.10+ audiences who prefer the shorter union syntax.
